testcase.name: counters are deltas and drain to nothing()
fps is emitted once a window has closed and not before()
a stream that has shown nothing has no frame age()
a decoder restart does not subtract, and the readings after it are right()
the decoder's first total is not credited to the first flush()
a clock that went backwards restarts the window rather than stalling it()
a drain before any frame reports nothing at all()
a new stream does not inherit the old decoder's baseline()
later totals are reported as the delta between them()
a counter that went backwards does not erase drops that really happened()
a closed stream stops claiming an age()
a frozen stream reports a large age rather than going quiet()
frame age is how long ago the last frame arrived()
dropping zero frames is not an event()
a negative or non-finite fps never becomes a sample()
